mapper.select: SELECT target_id AS targetId, metric_key AS metricKey, DATE_FORMAT(collect_time, #{format}) AS bucketTime, ROUND(AVG(metric_value), 2) AS value FROM metric_data WHERE collect_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND target_id IN #{tid} AND metric_key IN #{mk} GROUP BY target_id, metric_key, bucketTime ORDER BY bucketTime ASC
